cases.title: run-N gives kind run with an integer n
cases.given: A scratch git repo with an empty .sdlc/config.json, and the built branches.py of the slice commit

cases.expected: kind run, integer n, exit 0, tree unchanged

seeds.title: parse accepts a trailing newline
seeds.detail: Python $ matches before a final newline. sdlc/M-2\n gives milestone M-2 and the tail keeps the newline. Git refuses newlines in branch names. Unchanged from round 0.

seeds.title: parse treats unicode digits as digits
seeds.detail: sdlc/run-٣ gives n 3 and sdlc/M-٢ gives milestone M-٢. The plan keeps this. Unchanged from round 0.

seeds.title: slash in an area is accepted (note only)
seeds.detail: sdlc/M-2-e2e-a/b gives e2e-area with area a/b, per ADR-20261009-173303-decision-judge-S-008-a88a.

seeds.title: the fix lifts the int string limit for the whole process
seeds.detail: branches.py calls sys.set_int_max_str_digits(0) at import. A caller that imports branches.py also loses the limit. A 100000 digit run number parses in 137 ms, so no slowdown shows today. A cap on digit count would keep the limit.
